data.body: Fixed: Added cross-source-key RED marker conflict detection to check-test-index-duplicates.sh. A new _check_cross_key_conflicts function scans for the same test file appearing under multiple source-key lines each with a different RED marker — the bash-runner last-entry-wins bug. The check runs both in the fast path (no source-key dups) and after auto-union (for cases where dups existed). On conflict, exits 1 with an error listing the conflicting entries and source keys. Tests without markers are not affected. Added 4 new behavioral tests covering: fast-path rejection, no-marker same-test-file allowed, post-union detection, and combined dup+conflict scenario.
